description: Use when the user asks what the voices argued about a company, or what a person argued, in The Buildout; by slug, ticker or name. Returns where it appears, the figures the stories reported, each argument attributed, dated and linked, and for a listed company the delayed market snapshot with its source. Never a score or a ranking.

kind.description: Narrow the lookup to companies, to people or to the organizations that contribute argument (listed with the people).

name.description: The name, when the slug is not known.

slug.description: The entity slug, as in https://deepstack.ltd/companies/<slug>/ or /people/<slug>/.

ticker.description: A listed company’s ticker, for example NVDA.

name: deepstack_entity
title: A company or a person
